title: Nonempty fields in a well-formed table
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$, let $h$ be a list, and let $es$ be a list of lists of fields. Suppose $h$ is nonempty, every entry in $es$ has length $m$, and every field in every entry is nonempty. Then every field in the table formed by placing $h$ first and then all entries in $es$ is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: Every field in each entry is nonempty
